about.en: I'm Ray Tian, a first-year Honours Mathematics (Co-op) student at the University of Waterloo. I'm interested in software engineering, data science and quantitative development. I like problems that start from something concrete: a bug I can reproduce, a tool classmates actually need, a group that needs organizing. Away from the keyboard I play table tennis and piano, follow open-source projects, and enjoy rhythm games and interactive digital experiences.
about.zh: 我是 Ray Tian，滑铁卢大学数学荣誉学士（Co-op）大一学生，对软件工程、数据科学和量化开发感兴趣。我喜欢从具体问题出发：一个可以复现的 bug、同学真正需要的工具、一个需要有人组织的小组。离开键盘，我打乒乓球、弹钢琴，关注开源项目，也喜欢节奏游戏和互动式数字体验。
